items.title: Rock west of the Castle Town entrance
items.hint: Just outside the Castle Town gate, a glowing mark sits on a rock to the west. The fairy hid its whole fortune in a wooden crate nearby — break it open.

items.title: Mossy wall by the big tree
items.hint: On the road toward Kakariko, a mossy ruined wall beside a large tree carries a mark. The fairy hid something in the tree — shake it or roll into it.

items.title: Overturned cart by the dirt road
items.hint: Along the dirt road to Kakariko, an overturned cart has a mark on it. The fairy says little bugs skitter in the grass here — cut it down and catch some.

items.title: Ruins by the ranch fence
items.hint: Round the outside of Lon Lon Ranch to the ruins at its southwest corner, at the foot of an ivy-covered wall. Play the Sun’s Song beside the mark to restore health and magic.

items.title: Gossip Stone grotto south of the ranch
items.hint: South of the ranch, a grotto with a gossip stone hides a mark inside. As a child, clear the Skulltula off the wall; come back as an adult and the fairy has caught the golden bug — break the crate below for its token.

items.title: Tree east of the Castle Town entrance
items.hint: As an adult, a tree just east of the Castle Town gate holds a thought about a first purchase — and the password for the Business Scrub in the grotto by the drawbridge. Remember it, then return as a child to buy the Heart Piece.

items.title: Chest cave by Gerudo Valley
items.hint: Near the stone arch by Gerudo Valley, a mark by the cave urges you to take what is in the chest — the lock was left undone. As an adult it is already open and empty; come back as a child.

items.title: Rock nook in the northwest, by the river
items.hint: In a rock nook by the river at the northwest edge of the field, a fairy complains about the big Peahats. They fear fire — Din’s Fire is the answer.

items.title: Ruined stone pillar on the south edge
items.hint: At the southern edge of the field, east of the road down to Lake Hylia, a ruined stone pillar stands under a tree by a small pond. The mark warns never to point a stick at a butterfly — hold out a Deku Stick and one will land on it and turn into a fairy.

items.title: Rock nook south of the Zora River entrance
items.hint: On the rock wall at the eastern edge of the field, just south of the entrance to Zora River, a fairy loves laying rupees out in patterns — check the puddles, pits, and water nearby.

items.title: Ivy wall behind the stable
items.hint: Go around behind the house and the stable to the garden. The thought is on the ivy-covered brick wall, among some crates, barrels, and a wooden cart. The cows love that kid’s song — play Epona’s Song for one and it gives milk.

items.title: Glowing stone in the Royal Family’s Tomb
items.hint: Inside the Royal Family’s Tomb, a glowing blue stone in the inner room holds a thought about a song carved on a monument. Play the Sun’s Song here to restore health and magic.

items.title: Broken stones at the tomb entrance
items.hint: Among the broken stones by the entrance of the Royal Family’s Tomb, a child hears that the Sun’s Song freezes ReDeads in place.

items.title: Trail wall on Death Mountain
items.hint: A mark is carved into the trail wall on the way up the mountain, best found at night. The fairy watches leaves drift in slow circles until a storm spins them fast — play the Song of Storms and the spinning leaf lifts off a grotto entrance below.

items.title: Shore of Lake Hylia
items.hint: A mark glows in an alcove on the west shore of the lake, near its south end. The fairy is hiding in one of the nearby pots — break them for a bottled fairy and some rupees.

items.title: Cliff path along Zora’s River
items.hint: On the cliff trail past a crumbling arch, a glowing rock face holds a thought about bugs and soft soil. Release a bottled bug into the dirt pile by the bean seller and a hidden Skulltula pops out.

items.title: Spirit Temple ledge
items.hint: On the ledge outside the Spirit Temple, between the chests, a fairy complains about the dry air and wishes for rain. Play the Song of Storms here to restore health and magic. Readable at either age.

items.title: Inside the Shadow Temple
items.hint: Deep in the Shadow Temple, in a barred hall, a mark wishes for a big, strong blast of wind. Play the Song of Storms here to restore health and magic.

items.title: Inside the Bottom of the Well
items.hint: Down in the well, beside a coffin in the room with the mummified creatures, a fairy misses an old man’s song about going round and round. Play the Song of Storms here to restore health and magic.

items.title: Inside the Ice Cavern
items.hint: Late in the frozen corridor, a fairy complains about the cold and wishes for a few warm moments in the sun. Play the Sun’s Song here to restore health and magic.

items.title: Inside the Forest Temple
items.hint: On the third floor, in the blue hall with the stained-glass windows, a mark finds the room cosy but a little damp. Play the Sun’s Song here to restore health and magic.

items.title: Inside the Fire Temple
items.hint: On the fifth floor, on the path to the right of the hammer chest, a fairy loves bright places and wonders how to make the lava-lit rooms even brighter. Play the Sun’s Song here to restore health and magic.

items.title: Inside the Water Temple
items.hint: In a side room of the Water Temple, a mark finds the humidity something else and misses the sun. Play the Sun’s Song here to restore health and magic.
